name: custtoolset_pillar7_extractor
description: Extracts aggregated system data to calculate the overarching NetSuite System Health Score across performance, stability, architectural cleanliness, and security posture.

analysisType.description: The specific aggregate metric to pull for scoring. Use 'performance_stability' for execution times and error rates, 'architectural_cleanliness' for the active vs. inactive asset ratio, or 'security_posture' for login failures and token anomalies.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing high-level aggregated numbers used to calculate the 0-100 system health score and benchmark against SuiteSuccess standards.
